title: Audio comparison viewer
responsibility: Opens paired recordings in a modal for listening to either side or both.

inputs.name: AudioComparisonViewer.before
inputs.description: The Evidence record for the before recording: its title is the modal title in the Before view, and its pane is shown in the Before and Compare views, keyed by its id, with its source shown as the heading commit (first seven characters). A null or undefined value throws TypeError, and an id equal to the after record's id throws each_key_duplicate in Compare view.

examples.title: Login narration
examples.source: Manual audio upload · recording date not supplied

inputs.name: AudioComparisonViewer.after
inputs.description: The Evidence record for the after recording: its title is the modal title in the After and Compare views and appears in the region's aria-label in every view, and its pane is shown in the After and Compare views, keyed by its id, with its source shown as the heading commit (first seven characters). A null or undefined value throws TypeError, and an id equal to the before record's id throws each_key_duplicate in Compare view.

examples.title: Login narration
examples.source: Manual audio upload · recording date not supplied

inputs.name: AudioComparisonViewer.assetBase
inputs.description: The prefix that AudioEvidence joins directly to each shown recording's file name (its src is assetBase + file, with no separator added), so it must end with the separator the path needs, such as '/media/'. The viewer passes it unchanged to every shown card and does not validate it.

inputs.name: AudioComparisonViewer.onclose
inputs.description: close() calls this callback once per call, after it has closed the enclosing dialog natively (only if that dialog is open) so the browser can return focus to the opener. Its return value is ignored, and an error it throws propagates out of close().

outputs.name: AudioComparisonViewer
outputs.description: The lightbox Modal, open on mount and starting in the Compare view, with Before, After and Compare toggle buttons and one AudioEvidence card per shown recording. Mounting pauses every <audio> element in the document, and a card that leaves the view is destroyed, which pauses its playback.

errors.name: onclose callback error
errors.description: An error thrown by onclose is not caught in close(), so it propagates out of close() after the enclosing dialog has been closed (if it was open).

errors.name: each_key_duplicate
errors.description: ComparePanes keys each shown pane by its key, which is the recording id here, and shows both panes only in the Compare view (the initial view), so an id shared by before and after makes Svelte's keyed each raise each_key_duplicate.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: A null or undefined before or after throws TypeError during render, because the viewer reads each recording's id and source to build the panes and after.title for the region label.
